About AtariAtari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Hipster Whale, Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, in France, Germany, Sweden, and India.About the roleMünster, Germany · Part-timeThe Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.What you’ll do- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.Requirements & Qualifications- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.Nice to have- Professional proficiency in French.- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.How you’ll workThis role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice. Your value will come from being dependable, organised and persistent, and from creating enough structure that the CFO and specialist advisers can make decisions and complete formalities efficiently.The role requires flexibility in working hours to accommodate cross-border coordination with the CFO in France, banks, advisers and teams in other time zones.Why join AtariThis role sits at the centre of an international finance and governance environment. You will work across Germany, France, Luxembourg and other Atari Group locations, helping coordinate the formalities and projects that support the Group’s entities and operations.You will have visibility across Finance, Legal and senior leadership, with the opportunity to build a reliable operating rhythm for corporate administration and cross-border coordination as Atari continues to integrate and develop its international business.EEO StatementAtari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. jobs.description: Shape compliance. Drive governance. Protect global business. At DHL Group, we connect people and improve lives through our global logistics network. We are looking for an experienced Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our insurance activities remain compliant, transparent, and future-ready. This position combines insurance taxation, regulatory compliance, governance, and stakeholder management in a highly international environment. Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d)   Why experienced insurance professionals join this role* Move from advising to owning insurance governance decisions.* Shape multinational insurance programs across a global organization.* Influence strategic decisions involving Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, and Risk Management.* Work at the intersection of insurance, regulation, governance, and business strategy.* Gain exposure to some of the most complex international insurance arrangements in the market. You'll make an impact by:* Defining and evolving DHL Group's global insurance governance framework.* Ensuring regulatory excellence across international insurance programs.* Leading complex tax, regulatory, and compliance initiatives.* Managing interactions with authorities, regulators, auditors, brokers, and insurers.* Providing strategic guidance on multinational insurance structures and cross-border risk solutions. What You Will Do:Insurance Tax & Compliance* Serve as the central expert for insurance premium tax matters in Germany.* Advise business stakeholders on insurance taxation, insurance distribution compliance, and regulatory requirements.* Assess domestic and international insurance programs, including multinational insurance structures, global master policies, local policies, captive insurance arrangements, and Freedom of Services (FOS) solutions.* Review and evaluate insurance premium tax treatment for insurance contracts and insurance-related services.* Support the design, implementation, and launch of new insurance programs while ensuring tax and regulatory compliance. Governance & Risk Management* Maintain and continuously improve insurance tax governance and compliance frameworks.* Design and oversee internal control systems for insurance premium tax processes.* Contribute to the enhancement of DHL Group's Tax Compliance Management System.* Conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews related to insurance distribution and taxation.* Promote transparency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across the organization.  Regulatory & Audit Management* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany. Cross-Functional Collaboration* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. What You Bring* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency. Who You AreYou are a strategic and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex regulatory environments. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality. What We Offer* A highly visible role with global impact across one of the world's leading logistics companies.* Exposure to complex international insurance, tax, and compliance topics.* Opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.* A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.* Continuous professional development and career growth opportunities within DHL Group.(Employer value proposition formulated based on the role's global scope and responsibilities.) Why DHL Group?At DHL Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow. We value diverse perspectives and believe that our people are the key to our success. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and performance. Your benefits * Well-Being: Fun, team spirit, and health are crucial factors. Therefore, within the company, we offer a wide range of health and preventive care services, an occupational physician* Family-friendly: The compatibility of family and work has many facets, such as childcare, care for family members, etc. We support this, for example, through kindergarten places as well as the Betreuungs- und Erholungswerk (support and recreation program).* Employee Share Program: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in DHL Group's employee share program and share directly in the company's long-term success.* Mobility: We move not only letters or parcels but also our employees through offerings such as company bicycles, job tickets and possibly company cars.* Location: The Post Campus brings together people from more than 60 countries. The Post Tower is easily accessible by car, public transportation and bicycle. To facilitate the workday, the campus offers amenities such as parking spaces, post office, café, canteen and more.* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program, etc., lay the foundation for a successful start at DHL Group.* Development opportunities: We offer numerous development opportunities through a comprehensive training landscape, junior talent programs, coaching etc.* Social commitment: Through global corporate programs, we improve the educational and career opportunities for young people and engage in disaster management at airports.
